title: Tool descriptions allow less or more than the tools accept, so agents' calls get refused

regression.report: Most refusals stopped after release; read limits are still refused

whatHappens: An agent follows a tool description, and the tool refuses: an unstated size limit, a delete it says agents may do, cursor or search fields, artifact lookups.

fixes.text: Align tool descriptions with accepted arguments (#2991)

observations.text: Feedback: 14 reports from 6 agents, 10-30 13:41 to 10-31 08:46 UTC: wake prompt limit unstated, own schedule delete refused (403), read cursor and search fields, artifact read fields, stop, no_reply_needed and report length.
